lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: giaanee dhiaanee aakh sunaae ||
lines.translation: The spiritual teachers and meditators proclaim this.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਮਾਹੇ ਆਪੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਹੋਰ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sabhanaa rijak samaahe aape keemat hor na hoee he ||2||
lines.translation: He Himself nourishes all; no one else can estimate His value. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਅੰਧਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa mohu a(n)dh a(n)dhaaraa ||
lines.translation: Love and attachment to Maya are utter darkness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai meraa pasariaa paasaaraa ||
lines.translation: Egotism and possessiveness have spread throughout the expanse of the universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਲਤ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: anadin jalat rahai din raatee gur bin saa(n)t na hoee he ||3||
lines.translation: Night and day, they burn, day and night; without the Guru, there is no peace or tranquility. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜੋੜਿ ਵਿਛੋੜੇ ਆਪੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape joR vichhoRe aape ||
lines.translation: He Himself unites, and He Himself separates.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪੇ ਆਪੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape thaap uthaape aape ||
lines.translation: He Himself establishes, and He Himself disestablishes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ਹੋਰਨਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa hukam sachaa paasaaraa horan hukam na hoee he ||4||
lines.translation: True is the Hukam of His Command, and True is the expanse of His universe. No one else can issue any Command. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਲਾਇ ਲਏ ਸੋ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape laai lae so laagai ||
lines.translation: He alone is attached to the Lord, whom the Lord attaches to Himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee jam kaa bhau bhaagai ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, the fear of death runs away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar sabad sadaa sukhadaataa guramukh boojhai koee he ||5||
lines.translation: The Shabad, the Giver of peace, dwells forever deep within the nucleus of the self. One who is Gurmukh understands. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape mele mel milaae ||
lines.translation: God Himself unites those united in His Union.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੁਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋ ਮੇਟਣਾ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: purab likhiaa so metanaa na jaae ||
lines.translation: Whatever is pre-ordained by destiny, cannot be erased.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: anadin bhagat kare din raatee guramukh sevaa hoee he ||6||
lines.translation: Night and day, His devotees worship Him, day and night; one who becomes Gurmukh serves Him. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sev sadaa sukh jaataa ||
lines.translation: Serving the True Guru, lasting peace is experienced.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਇ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape aai miliaa sabhanaa kaa daataa ||
lines.translation: He Himself, the Giver of all, has come and met me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਚੀਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: haumai maar trisanaa agan nivaaree sabad cheen sukh hoee he ||7||
lines.translation: Subduing egotism, the fire of thirst has been extinguished; contemplating the Word of the Shabad, peace is found. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaiaa kuta(n)b mohu na boojhai ||
lines.translation: One who is attached to his body and family, does not understand.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਤ ਆਖੀ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh hovai ta aakhee soojhai ||
lines.translation: But one who becomes Gurmukh, sees the Lord with his eyes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: anadin naam ravai din raatee mil preetam sukh hoee he ||8||
lines.translation: Night and day, he chants the Naam, day and night; meeting with his Beloved, he finds peace. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਧਾਤੁ ਦੂਜੈ ਹੈ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh dhaat doojai hai laagaa ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukh wanders distracted, attached to duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮਤ ਕੀ ਨ ਮੂਓ ਆਭਾਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: janamat kee na mooo aabhaagaa ||
lines.translation: That unfortunate wretch - why didn't he just die as soon as he was born?

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: aavat jaat birathaa janam gavaaiaa bin gur mukat na hoee he ||9||
lines.translation: Coming and going, he wastes away his life in vain. Without the Guru, liberation is not obtained. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੁਸੁਧ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaiaa kusudh haumai mal laaee ||
lines.translation: That body which is stained with the filth of egotism is false and impure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਧੋਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: je sau dhovahi taa mail na jaaee ||
lines.translation: It may be washed a hundred times, but its filth is still not removed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਧੋਪੈ ਤਾ ਹਛੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਮੈਲੀ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: sabad dhopai taa hachhee hovai phir mailee mool na hoee he ||10||
lines.translation: But if it is washed with the Word of the Shabad, then it is truly cleansed, and it shall never be soiled again. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਕਾਇਆ ਸੰਘਾਰਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)ch doot kaaiaa sa(n)ghaarahi ||
lines.translation: The five demons destroy the body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਵੀਚਾਰਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: mar mar ja(n)mahi sabad na veechaarahi ||
lines.translation: He dies and dies again, only to be reincarnated; he does not contemplate the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ ਜਿਉ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਸੁਧਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar maaiaa moh gubaaraa jiu supanai sudh na hoee he ||11||
lines.translation: The darkness of emotional attachment to Maya is within his inner being; as if in a dream, he does not understand. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਪੰਚਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਹੈ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik pa(n)chaa maar sabad hai laage ||
lines.translation: Some conquer the five demons, by being attached to the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਇ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur aai miliaa vadabhaage ||
lines.translation: They are blessed and very fortunate; the True Guru comes to meet them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਰਵਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar saach ravahi ra(n)g raate sahaj samaavai soee he ||12||
lines.translation: Within the nucleus of their inner being, they dwell upon the Truth; attuned to the Lord's Love, they intuitively merge in Him. ||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਾਲ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kee chaal guroo te jaapai ||
lines.translation: The Guru's Way is known through the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਿਞਾਪੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: pooraa sevak sabad sinjaapai ||
lines.translation: His perfect servant attains realization through the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਵੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa sabad ravai ghat a(n)tar rasanaa ras chaakhai sach soee he ||13||
lines.translation: Deep within his heart, he dwells forever upon the Shabad; he tastes the sublime essence of the True Lord with his tongue. ||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai maare sabad nivaare ||
lines.translation: Egotism is conquered and subdued by the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam rakhai ur dhaare ||
lines.translation: I have enshrined the Name of the Lord within my heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਉ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: ekas bin hau hor na jaanaa sahaje hoi s hoee he ||14||
lines.translation: Other than the One Lord, I know nothing at all. Whatever will be, will automatically be. ||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਹਜੁ ਕਿਨੈ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin satigur sahaj kinai nahee paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Without the True Guru, no one obtains intuitive wisdom.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh boojhai sach samaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh understands, and is immersed in the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਖੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa sev sabad sach raate haumai sabade khoee he ||15||
lines.translation: He serves the True Lord, and is attuned to the True Shabad. The Shabad banishes egotism. ||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape gunadaataa beechaaree ||
lines.translation: He Himself is the Giver of virtue, the Contemplative Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਪਕੀ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh devahi pakee saaree ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh is given the winning dice.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਤੇ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam samaavahi saachai saache te pat hoee he ||16||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, immersed in the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one becomes true; from the True Lord, honor is obtained. ||16||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਏਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jagajeevan saachaa eko daataa ||
lines.translation: One One True Lord is the Life of the World, the Great Giver.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur sevaa te sabad pachhaataa ||
lines.translation: Serving the Guru, through the Word of the Shabad, He is realized.
